mentions.name: Postply
mentions.description: This app uses full context to generate better AI replies on X, Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn. It supports custom reply profiles and styles, aiming to produce more meaningful replies than the generic AI responses common on social media.
mentions.problem: AI replies on social media are already widespread but generic and bad.
mentions.audience: Support teams and social media managers
mentions.source_excerpt:
Postply uses full-context to generate better replies on X, Instagram, Facebook & LinkedIn.
It supports custom reply profiles and styles for support teams and social media managers.
